text:
emily: quick report from support: onboarding flow produced duplicate webhook deliveries when a token refresh hit a 429. not a platform outage but customer-facing and noisy.
dan: do we have a sanitized trace?
emily: tiny snippet:
```
2026-03-24T10:01:03Z req=note-77 status=429 retry-after=0.4
2026-03-24T10:01:03Z sdk retried req=note-77 idempotency_key=none
2026-03-24T10:01:04Z server processed webhook_post idempotency_key=none
```
lucas: classic race. quick proposals: (1) make sample apps attach Idempotency-Key by default for mutating endpoints (opt-out flag). (2) add a short "safe-window" in SDKs to suppress immediate replay during token refresh (default 20s). (3) use jittered exp backoff that respects Retry-After.
dan: +1. also add a tiny debug marker header that only sends low-cardinality metadata when sampling. name idea: `X-Rw-Debug-Sample: 1` and `X-Rw-Sample-Info: v1;sdk=js;tag=throttle` sent only when sampling triggers. infra can choose to persist boolean and short tag.
emily: sample-app pseudocode for guidance:
```js
// mutating request
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = opts.idempotencyKey || uuidv4()
if (duringRetry && shouldSample()) {
  headers['X-Rw-Debug-Sample'] = '1'
  headers['X-Rw-Sample-Info'] = 'v1;sdk=node;tag=throttle'
}
await retryWithBackoff({initialMs:150, maxMs:15000, jitter:true, honorRetryAfter:true, safeWindowMs:20000})
```
lucas: important caveat: do NOT auto-add idempotency keys for streaming/generation endpoints by default. those flows have partial outputs and long-lived state. document explicit opt-in for streaming.
dan: action items: 1) devex write RFC proposing sample-app defaults + SDK config parity (autoIdempotency, safeWindowMs, sampleRate). 2) infra/runtime accept `X-Rw-Debug-Sample` and index short tags for a short debug retention window (no PII). 3) SDK teams add opt-out flags and update sample apps. 4) docs add onboarding note about idempotency and streaming exceptions.
infra-bot: created issue devex-1102: "sample-app idempotency + safe-window RFC" (assignee: @lucas) :spiral_note_pad:
emily: please include a compatibility note for older SDKs: servers should treat absent idempotency as no guarantee; we shouldn't change server semantics.
dan: yep. RFC should include test plan and a small telemetry privacy checklist.
lucas: i'll draft RFC and ping eng-runtime to confirm they can mark sampled traces before scrubbing. i'll post link here when ready.
emily: thanks all — small changes but should cut a bunch of support noise. :thumbsup:
